subject: Compliance call orchestration: SOC 2 / DPA / pen-test time slicing
messages:
From: Tom Wallace <tom.wallace@acmepayments.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security_ops@acmepayments.com
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance review — SOC2 / DPA / pen-test intake?

Hi Irene,

Hope you’re well. We’re getting our compliance intake lined up and want to schedule a consolidated session to cover: SOC 2 scope review, DPA terms touchpoint, and a quick run-down for an upcoming vendor pen-test. Target duration is 60–90 minutes.

High-level ask: could Redwood run a combined walkthrough for our security and legal teams next week (week of Jul 26)? Our stakeholders: myself (security lead), Emma (legal, privacy), and our infra engineer (will want details on evidence transfer).

Can you share three possible slots (including one evening/after-hours option for our EMEA folks) and who from Redwood would attend?

We’ve attached our intake checklist for context.

Thanks,
Tom Wallace
Security Lead | Acme Payments
[Attachment: ACME-Compliance-Intake.pdf (PDF)]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Wallace <tom.wallace@acmepayments.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 18:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance review — SOC2 / DPA / pen-test intake?

Hi Tom — thanks for the note and for sharing the intake PDF. Happy to run a consolidated session. Proposed windows (90 min preferred to leave Q&A):

- Mon Jul 26 16:00–17:30 PDT / 23:00–00:30 CEST (evening slot)
- Tue Jul 27 09:00–10:30 PDT / 18:00–19:30 SGT (APAC-friendly day slot)
- Wed Jul 28 11:00–12:30 PDT (regular day)

Attendees from Redwood: Myself (security product), Jordan Blake (compliance ops), Marissa Cole (support/implementation).

Prep notes: please confirm
- The final attendee list and roles (so we can tailor the agenda)
- Whether you prefer we upload evidence to a shared Drive folder ahead of the call or use screen-sharing during the session

I’m attaching a short SOC2 evidence map that correlates to what we’ll review on the call — it should make the walk-through more efficient.

If none of those fit, share 2–3 times that do and we’ll pivot.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Security Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2-evidence-map.pdf (PDF)]

From: Tom Wallace <tom.wallace@acmepayments.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security_ops@acmepayments.com
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance review — SOC2 / DPA / pen-test intake?

Hi Irene — appreciate the options. Quick update: our CFO + a primary exec will be in a board prep that week and the daytime windows are tight. Two asks:

1) Can we move toward an evening slot (our exec can do a late-evening UTC-friendly time)
2) We’ll need a short DPA pre-read sent to legal before the call — any chance you can include the standard redline we typically see?

Suggested: Wed Jul 28 19:00–20:30 UTC (this maps to your Wed Jul 28 11:00 PDT suggestion if that helps). I’m also attaching our access checklist so you can see who needs host access and what to expect for the pen test run-through.

If that works I’ll lock it and send calendar invites to our team.

Thanks — Tom
Tom Wallace
Security Lead | Acme Payments
[Attachment: Acme-Access-Checklist.xlsx (XLSX)]

Tom / Irene — thanks for the back-and-forth. Confirming we’ll take the Wed Jul 28 19:00–20:30 UTC slot. I’ve created a shared Drive folder and a calendar invite (links below) — please upload any evidence or DPA redline items to the Drive ahead of time if possible (legal prefers 48h pre-read).

Quick logistics checklist for the call:
- Duration: 90 minutes (60 min walkthrough + 30 min Q&A)
- Bridge: Zoom (hosted by Redwood) — invite has dial-in + recording enabled
- Requested pre-read: DPA redline, any SOC2 control evidence docs, pen-test scope doc
- Primary Redwood attendees: Irene (security product), Jordan (compliance ops), Marissa (implementation)

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=acme-review-20260728
Shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleSharedDrive

Attaching the ICS calendar file and adding a short (1-pager) DPA summary to the Drive for legal to review. If anything changes on your side, flag here and we’ll adjust.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Compliance Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: calendar-invite-July28.ics (ICS)]
